changeSet.sql: UPDATE CM_ENGINE_COMMAND SET OPERATION_ID_ = ID_, TENANT_ID_ = '__legacy_unscoped__', IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_ = 'legacy:' || ID_, TARGET_IDENTITY_ = COALESCE( CASE TYPE_ WHEN 'CREATE_TASK' THEN JSON_VALUE(PAYLOAD_JSON_, '$.planItemId') WHEN 'CLAIM_TASK' THEN JSON_VALUE(PAYLOAD_JSON_, '$.engineTaskId') WHEN 'COMPLETE_TASK' THEN JSON_VALUE(PAYLOAD_JSON_, '$.engineTaskId') WHEN 'START_PROCESS' THEN COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(PAYLOAD_JSON_, '$.processDefinitionId'), JSON_VALUE(PAYLOAD_JSON_, '$.processDefinitionKey')) WHEN 'CANCEL_PROCESS' THEN JSON_VALUE(PAYLOAD_JSON_, '$.processInstanceId') WHEN 'DEPLOY_ORCHESTRATION' THEN JSON_VALUE(PAYLOAD_JSON_, '$.definitionKey') WHEN 'CORRELATE_MESSAGE' THEN JSON_VALUE(PAYLOAD_JSON_, '$.messageName') END, CASE_ID_), UPDATED_AT_ = CREATED_AT_, DECIDED_AT_ = CREATED_AT_, TOTAL_DISPATCH_ATTEMPTS_ = CASE WHEN STATUS_ IN ('CLAIMED','DONE') THEN ATTEMPTS_ + 1 ELSE ATTEMPTS_ END, AUTO_ATTEMPTS_ = CASE WHEN STATUS_ IN ('CLAIMED','DONE') THEN ATTEMPTS_ + 1 ELSE ATTEMPTS_ END, BUDGET_EPOCH_ = 0, AUTO_BUDGET_RESET_ = 0, ROW_VERSION_ = 0, ACTION_COUNT_ = 0, ACTION_HIGH_WATER_ = 0, ACTION_RESET_COUNT_ = 0, ACTION_CANCEL_COUNT_ = 0, LEGACY_ROW_ID_ = CASE WHEN STATUS_ = 'DONE' THEN ID_ END, LEGACY_STATUS_ = CASE WHEN STATUS_ = 'DONE' THEN 'DONE' END, LEGACY_MIGRATION_REF_ = CASE WHEN STATUS_ = 'DONE' THEN 'ws4-task2' END, LEGACY_MIGRATED_AT_ = CASE WHEN STATUS_ = 'DONE' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP END, LEGACY_FAILURE_COUNT_ = CASE WHEN STATUS_ = 'DONE' THEN ATTEMPTS_ END, CONFIRM_SOURCE_ = CASE WHEN STATUS_ = 'DONE' THEN 'LEGACY_MIGRATION' END, CONFIRMED_AT_ = CASE WHEN STATUS_ = 'DONE' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP END, FAILED_AT_ = CASE WHEN STATUS_ = 'DEAD' THEN CREATED_AT_ END, RAW_LEGACY_PAYLOAD_ = PAYLOAD_JSON_, PAYLOAD_JSON_ = COALESCE(PAYLOAD_JSON_, '{}'), RAW_LEGACY_ERROR_ = LAST_ERROR_, RAW_LEGACY_CLAIM_TOKEN_ = CLAIM_TOKEN_, RAW_LEGACY_CLAIMED_AT_ = CLAIMED_AT_, RAW_LEGACY_ATTEMPTS_ = ATTEMPTS_, RAW_LEGACY_CREATED_AT_ = CREATED_AT_, RAW_LEGACY_UPDATED_AT_ = CREATED_AT_, MIGRATION_BASELINE_DECIDED_AT_ = CREATED_AT_, MIGRATION_BASELINE_ACTIVE_ = 1, ORIGINAL_STATUS_ = STATUS_, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT_ = CASE WHEN STATUS_ = 'RETRYING' THEN NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT_ END, STATUS_ = CASE STATUS_ WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 'RETRYING' THEN 'RETRYABLE' WHEN 'CLAIMED' THEN 'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION' WHEN 'DONE' THEN 'CONFIRMED' WHEN 'DEAD' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE STATUS_ END, CLAIM_TOKEN_ = NULL, CLAIMED_AT_ = NULL WHERE OPERATION_ID_ IS NULL
UPDATE CM_ENGINE_COMMAND SET DECIDED_AT_=LEGACY_MIGRATED_AT_, CONFIRMED_AT_=LEGACY_MIGRATED_AT_, MIGRATION_BASELINE_DECIDED_AT_=LEGACY_MIGRATED_AT_ WHERE CONFIRM_SOURCE_='LEGACY_MIGRATION'
